F3_size_check_MEDIUM.finding_accepted: against an exchangeable calibration ensemble the iid validation ensembles' rejection rate is alpha by construction; they cannot see a data-versus-pseudo difference, and at n = 300 the four checks had low assurance and the Bonferroni 'simultaneous' clause of T6 was dropped silently
F3_size_check_MEDIUM.repair: the size-validation ensembles of amendment 5 (2 x 300) are WITHDRAWN. T6's size clause is re-specified (retrospective motivation: this finding) as process sensitivity: the pseudo process differs from the data process by the unfolding-MC size (F4) and by the within-fine-cell shapes (F2, bounded by the fine null). A per-null shift D enters the evaluation as calibration variants f -> f + c D, c in (0, 1/2, 1); each test's CLAIM p-value is the LARGEST over the variants and Holm uses the claim p-values (a rejection must hold under every variant). For each null the implied size of the unshifted test at c = 1/2 is reported; if it exceeds 0.08 the unshifted p-value is shown as 'not calibrated for the data process' and only the claim p-value is quoted. Rank-test exactness within the pseudo process holds by construction; the implementation is protected by disjoint seed ranges (enforced when the production tables are generated) and the unit tests of s5p_joint

F4_half_versus_full_MC_MEDIUM.finding_accepted: the reviewer's comparison (pseudo mean against the full-MC self-asimov) mixes the MC-size effect with effects the real data share (the data are independent of the MC, as the pseudo-data are); the relevant difference is the unfolding-MC size at fixed independent pseudo-data
F4_half_versus_full_MC_MEDIUM.measurement: D_G = mean over four split keys of f(half MC) - f(quarter MC) on the J cells, from the noise-free (expectation) pseudo process at the null truth G (s5p_nullexp.py --no-nuisance --expectation --mc-fraction half|quarter; seeds 970000-970003 at the MnvTune null, the other nulls after the F1 predictions exist; s5p_pairdiff.py); under a 1/n_MC bias law the half-to-full shift is D/2, under 1/sqrt(n) about 0.71 D, hence the variants c = 1/2 and 1
F4_half_versus_full_MC_MEDIUM.use: the per-null D files (npz 'D_J', sha256) are named in the production design ('process_shift'); the claim rule of F3 applies
